cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. To get your sofa off the ceiling, turn the gravity dial politely. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm losing my deposit. How do I turn politely?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Pause at each number. They dislike being passed over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six clicked, but now the armchairs are rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six has invited witnesses. Apologize to the whole suite; private apologies don't count once furniture assembles.

mechanism: A directs a gravity repair and takes financial or social burden while confidently inventing courtesy rules in response to each new floating item.
confusable: Unlike simply seeking apologies to objects, A changes the operating rules to solve the physical problem as consequences appear.
comparison: Tenant deposit and furniture assembly differ from a novice cloud measurement.
